question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed external-plugin `safetyDiagnostics` capability and durable AI-safety event history as supported core contracts?
rationale: This choice sets a long-lived plugin SDK, manifest, security-provenance, storage, and operator-observability boundary; implementation review cannot determine the desired permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow core contract
options.body: Sponsor a minimal, documented event and permission contract, then require upgrade/privacy and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep observability plugin-owned
options.body: Retain only generic existing diagnostics seams and move optional safety dashboards and event integrations outside the core contract.

options.title: Defer the feature direction
options.body: Pause this PR until an owner defines the required event families, retention policy, and external-plugin compatibility guarantee.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a minimal, documented event and permission contract, then require upgrade/privacy and live behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They can provide the feature rationale and implementation context, while the final core-contract decision requires an appropriate repository owner.
